# Retained cam regression fixture

Preserved verbatim from pre-pruning source `552d5e9447cd6a9323afc378a2084205735c23ca`.
The sample was removed from the public catalog during M92 curation.
These source/compiler bytes retain the independently measured tangent-offset and passive-follower
locality regression in `m92_mechanism_drag_witnesses`; they are not registered or bundled at runtime.
